scenes.text: Nepal’s heat is felt most in the plains below the mountains: the Terai.
Before the monsoon, the heat is dry and fierce. Then it turns humid, and nights stop cooling down.
Nepal’s 2024 national heatwave plan gives agencies their roles for warnings, water, health, schools, electricity and workplaces.
And local plans lead the way: Nepalgunj wrote the country’s first in 2023, and Dhangadhi followed.
National roles, local plans, one season at a time.
